s1612-river-before.png: Previous1.6.11 appearance at matched approved Reference values/camera. Reflective far water remains comparatively grey.
s1612-river-off.png: New source, texture strength zero. Clear optics; above-water banks/foliage keep their palette.
s1612-river-half.png: Half strength gives an intermediate surface colour over the visible river.
s1612-river-on.png: Default=max. Tint remains visible across middle/far reflective water; no nearby-only boundary. Natural fog and animation remain.
s1612-close-off.png: Matched close zero-strength view with visible shallow bed, shoreline and deep river.
s1612-close-on.png: Default=max. Shallow bed remains visible; tint covers both foreground and reflective middle/far water. Above-water shoreline and foliage unchanged in appearance.
s1612-grazing-off.png: Clear-surface control at low viewing angle; reflective river and shallow right bank remain visible.
s1612-grazing-on.png: Matched low-angle default. Blue surface tint remains visible on reflection-dominated water into the distance. Reflected cloud shapes and ripple detail remain; no tint leaks onto dry banks or trees.
s1612-downward-on.png: Straight-down90° finite regression. Bed and depth transitions remain coherent with whole-surface tint; no inverted patch, opaque rectangle or reflected-sky pole visible in this scene. Does not certify the unknown historical pole camera.
s1612-underwater-on.png: Underwater view towards water exit/air and banks. Straight-through optics, submerged attenuation and visible particles remain; surface-overlay path correctly bypassed underwater. Finite regression only.
s1612-preset-fast.png: Fast preset uses its unchanged lower-resolution optics; the whole-surface tint remains active and shallow-bed/shore transitions are coherent.
s1612-preset-balanced.png: Balanced preset retains half-resolution water and lighter refraction/cloud settings. Surface tint covers the visible river, with bed detail and shoreline retained.
s1612-preset-reference.png: Approved Reference values, including half-resolution water and sky-only reflections. Default tint covers the visible water; bed/shore detail remains.
s1612-preset-high.png: High retains full-resolution optics and scenery reflections at unchanged quality. Reflected cutout-tree detail remains present under the surface tint; screen-space/cutout limitations are not redesigned by this change.
s1612-fixture-wood-above.png: Existing normal-world fixture: submerged logs and stepped wood remain visible through the tinted surface with coherent depth and shore boundaries. No blocks were changed.
s1612-fixture-waterfall.png: Existing falling curtain/receiving pond: tint covers the waterfall and pond, stone remains visible through the curtain, and distant dry glass panes/terrain retain their appearance. No new opaque water rectangle in this finite view.
s1612-fixture-underwater.png: Existing underwater wood/pond viewed toward air. Submerged wood, pool floor and air-exit geometry remain coherent.
s1612-fixture-particles.png: Same underwater fixture with an emitted bubble command confirmed in server log. Ambient/visible particles remain; a still image alone does not certify bubble motion.
s1612-waterline-low.png: Just below surface: a rectangular sky/treetop tint band is visible. Not accepted as a clean waterline result; baseline comparison queued to distinguish an existing near-plane/exit issue from this surface change.
s1612-waterline-high.png: Just above surface: water coverage, tint/reflections and bank/air boundary remain coherent in this finite view.
s1612-glass-above.png: Four temporary glass blocks replace snapshotted source-water states in the existing fixture. Above-water bed/wood and water tint remain coherent through the clear pane. Exact water states restored after testing.
s1612-glass-underwater.png: Through-glass underwater fixture: wood, bed and geometry beyond the water exit remain visible without an opaque tinted rectangle.
s1612-glass-particles.png: Glass plus emitted bubble/ambient particles: finite transparency regression view; no opaque pane overlay. Motion/exhaustive particle types are not certified.
s1612-waterline-low-before.png: Previous1.6.11 at the identical just-below-surface camera reproduces the same rectangular sky/treetop tint band. Confirms a pre-existing waterline defect, not a new surface-tint regression. Waterline acceptance stays pending.
s1612-release-river.png: Actual final Stratus1.6.12 release ZIP, loaded in Iris at approved Reference defaults. Same clear whole-surface tint/bed/shore result as the byte-identical QA candidate. Waterline defect remains separately pending.
